2607.25590.title: PILA: Plug-and-Play Insertion for LLM-native Advertising
2607.25590.paper_summary: How to monetize large language models (LLMs) by naturally integrating sponsored content into their responses, known as LLM-native advertising, has recently emerged as a critical problem. However, existing solutions entangle advertising with content generation inside a single model, which is incompatible with modern API-only or workflow-based LLM applications and inevitably compromises the original response quality. To address this, we propose PILA, which reformulates ad insertion as a conditional response rewriting problem and decouples it from the upstream service as a lightweight sidecar module. PILA is model-agnostic and can be seamlessly integrated with existing LLM services without modifying the base model or its workflow. It also exposes a controllable trade-off between user-side naturalness and ad-side exposure, offering a practical interface for downstream pricing and deployment. Experiments across diverse upstream models show that \pila consistently improves ad effectiveness while preserving response quality, highlighting its promise as a practical solution for LLM-native advertising.
2607.25590.paper_summary_zh: 如何通過自然地將贊助內容整合到大型語言模型（LLMs）的回應中來實現貨幣化，這被稱為LLM原生廣告，最近已成為一個關鍵問題。<lb/>然而，現有的解決方案將廣告與內容生成糾纏在單一模型中，這與現代僅限API或基於工作流程的LLM應用程序不兼容，並不可避免地妥協了原始回應的質量。<lb/>為了解決這個問題，我們提出了PILA，它將廣告插入重新表述為條件回應重寫問題，並將其與上游服務解耦，作為一個輕量級的側車模塊。<lb/>PILA是模型無關的，可以無縫地與現有的LLM服務集成，而無需修改基礎模型或其工作流程。<lb/>它還提供了用戶端自然性與廣告端曝光之間可控的權衡，為下游定價和部署提供了實用的介面。<lb/>在多種上游模型上的實驗顯示，PILA始終提高了廣告的有效性，同時保持了回應質量，突顯了它作為LLM原生廣告實用解決方案的潛力。
